extensions.articleProcessing: Build-time context asides and grouped exercises retain italic prose with 1.6em group margins, without quotation bars or generated quotes. All article blockquotes retain italics but never display a left border. Omit rules immediately before chapters; promote structural labels explicitly while preserving wording and the existing type scale.
extensions.articleMedia: Explicit code role metadata uses native Expressive Code titles and copy controls. Tables use focusable scroll regions with preserved alignment and column scope. Standalone image titles become 14px muted captions; local PNG dimensions are added at build time.

motion.name: reduced-motion

motion.name: reading-motion
motion.value: 400ms first load; 240ms route enter; 300ms header morph; 90ms route exit; 40ms block stagger; 500ms TOC surface spring; cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Materializes viewport-sized blocks while route heroes remain their sole entrance owners and home content and complete article bodies stay stationary; article-list focus is opacity-only, simple portfolio destinations swap without a zero-opacity frame, article routes retain one deferred frame, and same-route hash history bypasses route motion.

motion.name: editorial-stagger
motion.value: 320ms headline visual spring with 0.1 bounce and strong ease-out opacity; 60ms line stagger; 180ms headline pause; 240ms follower visual spring with 0.1 bounce and strong ease-out opacity; 50ms follower stagger; 0.4em/14px travel; headline-only 4px one-shot blur
motion.purpose: Animates the Home, Articles, and article-detail heroes without changing established typography or spacing; reduced motion renders the complete hero immediately.

components.name: Expanded Diagram
components.description: A full-canvas native diagram viewer that preserves article rhythm and frames the original white teaching sketch against an independently fading dark scrim. Pointer activation fades the scrim over 160ms, then after a 40ms handoff brings the sheet from 10px below at 0.985 scale through a 240ms transform spring with a fast opacity handoff. Keyboard and reduced-motion activation remain instant; it also has background scroll lock, Escape, backdrop dismissal, and focus return.
components.html: Diagram
components.css: .diagram-trigger { display: block; width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: zoom-in; text-align: left; } .diagram-trigger__action { display: inline-block; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .diagram-dialog { width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem), 80rem); max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem); border: 0; background: transparent; } .diagram-dialog__canvas { border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-surface) 24%, transparent); background: white; } .diagram-dialog__image { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: calc(100vh - 7rem); margin: 0 auto; object-fit: contain; }

components.name: Floating Article Table of Contents
components.description: An xl-only fixed right Rare UI-inspired build-time minimap in a 96px aside, with marks beginning 32px from the right edge and expanding inward from the right. It preserves source order and includes up to 34 real H2-H4 anchors, evenly sampling in source order when needed. Major marks follow Rare's 6:34 ratio and scale down proportionally on shorter guides; every other sampled anchor uses the body/short preset. At full density the major marks occupy indices 0, 7, 13, 20, 26, and 33. Minor marks use muted foreground at 40%, and all use 1px strokes, 8px gaps, a 40px pointer radius, a connected surface label for hovered or keyboard-focused sections, semantic history-backed hash anchors, keyboard, Escape, route-safe lifecycle, and reduced-motion parity. An 80ms shared scroll pulse replaces persistent read-fill.
components.css: .floating-toc { position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 96px; } .floating-toc-rail { padding-left: 32px; } .floating-toc-dash { width: 110px; height: 1px; transform-origin: left center; } .floating-toc-dash-list { gap: 8px; } .floating-toc-dash--minor { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Mobile Article Table of Contents
components.description: A below-xl content-measured visual pill near 32px tall with a separate invisible 44px trigger target and a 20px current-section progress ring before the title. The same surface expands upward and in place into a content-measured w-max 26px squircle-style menu capped by the viewport and min(64dvh, 520px). A 98% surface compensates for the no-blur invariant while Rare's 60%-border token remains, with neutral 30px semantic anchor rows, transparent outside-click dismissal, inert background, safe areas, focus containment, Escape, focus return, optional bounded drag dismissal, source-like timing, and a 0.4s long-list stagger cap.

narrative.overview: A narrow, theme-aware portfolio and writing surface that emphasizes readable proof and technical depth over editorial display.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is reserved for links, list markers, series indices, inline code, focus, and selected evidence.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from sequence and spacing, not oversized display typography.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Rules and whitespace organize content; decorative cards and shadows do not.

dos: Keep pages inside the reading column.
Publish through validated series or topic frontmatter and lazy guide imports.
Use content-hashed resume PDF URLs while preserving a clean download name.
donts: Do not reintroduce serif display typography.
Do not add a second accent palette.
Do not override Expressive Code fenced blocks with legacy pre styles.
